body.zh: 把分数和错题告诉我，十分钟找出失分最多的地方和下一步练什么。
body.en: Share your scores and mistakes to see where most points went and what to practise next.

prompt.en: Help me analyse my latest exam.

body.zh: 先说说你当时怎么想的，一步步找到卡住的地方，再做一道同类题。
body.en: Explain how you approached it, find where you got stuck, then try a similar question.

prompt.zh: 这道题我为什么做错了？请先听我说当时怎么想的。
prompt.en: Help me understand this mistake. Ask how I approached it first.

title.en: Set up a Sunday mistake review

body.zh: 每周日晚上把这周的错题按知识点分组，挑出最值得重做的 3 道。
body.en: Every Sunday evening, group the week’s mistakes by topic and pick the 3 most worth redoing.
